requirements.requirement: A musical artist's first name is shared with, or forms part of, a charity's name; the charity is unrelated to the musical artist and was registered between 2000 and 2010 inclusive.
The musical artist died in a city; that city is located in a country and is 20 to 30 miles inclusive away from the site of that country's deadliest aviation accident as of 2023.
The musical artist's death was accidental, and the aviation accident identified as that country's deadliest aviation accident as of 2023 occurred 15 years prior to that accidental death.

The partner of the musical artist at the time of the artist's death gave an interview in which the partner said that, following the artist's death, the artist has become a direct reference to one of the artist's songs.
The title of the song to which the artist has become a direct reference is one word and is an adjective.
The requested answer is the title of that song.
